name: md-view
description: Electron + TypeScript Markdown previewer desktop app (structural scaffold)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npx esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload/index.js && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/renderer',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('src/renderer/index.html','dist/renderer/index.html');require('fs').copyFileSync('src/renderer/renderer.js','dist/renderer/renderer.js');require('fs').copyFileSync('node_modules/github-markdown-css/github-markdown.css','dist/renderer/github-markdown.css');require('fs').copyFileSync('node_modules/highlight.js/styles/github.css','dist/renderer/github.css')"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
